item.title: Is Trump preparing to strike Iran? US military assets move into position
item.description: US aircraft carriers, missile submarines, and stealth bombers are moving into striking range of Iran after Trump’s warning. Is Washington preparing for military action or sending a powerful message?

item.title: Sheikh Hasina urges people in Bangladesh to reclaim democracy, calls interim govt ‘corrupt’
item.description: From India, Sheikh Hasina delivers a fiery message to Bangladesh- calling the interim government fascist, warning of chaos and foreign interference, and urging citizens to rise and reclaim democracy.

item.title: Snowfall in hills, rain in plains brings back winter chill; IMD issues alert
item.description: Weather conditions across India have changed sharply as snowfall continues in hilly regions and rainfall affects the plains. Jammu and Kashmir, Himachal Pradesh, and Uttarakhand witnessed fresh snowfall, while rain brought down temperatures in Uttar Pradesh, Rajasthan, and Delhi.

item.title: “Mockery is not right,” says Dhirendra Shastri on Prayagraj Mela dispute; Click for details
item.description: The dispute between Jyotishpeeth Shankaracharya Swami Avimukteshwaranand and the Prayagraj Mela administration continues to escalate. Reacting to the controversy, Bageshwar Dham head Pandit Dhirendra Krishna Shastri appealed for restraint and dialogue.

item.description: Stay updated with the biggest headlines for Saturday, 24 January- politics, crime, sports, and more - all summarized for quick reading. Get instant access to breaking news, major developments, and trending stories in just one click. Perfect for busy readers who want news on the go.

item.title: Iran hits back at Trump’s threats, says “ready for any outcome”
item.description: Tensions between the United States and Iran have intensified after President Donald Trump issued strong warnings against Tehran. In response, Iran’s leadership said American threats would not affect its stance and claimed readiness for any outcome.

item.title: Republic Day 2026: DMRC to start Metro services early to ease commuter rush; Check timings
item.description: The Delhi Metro Rail Corporation has announced early operations on Republic Day 2026. On January 26, metro services on all lines will begin at 3:00 AM to facilitate smooth travel for people attending the Republic Day parade at Kartavya Path.

item.title: Gold prices edge higher in India as markets stay firm near record highs; Check rates here
item.description: Gold prices in India inched up marginally as bullion markets remained steady near record levels amid global uncertainty. Silver also posted a slight rise, supported by strong industrial demand. Experts say currency movements, interest-rate expectations, and geopolitical tensions continue to influence prices.

item.title: Ishan Kishan’s 76 off 32 sets the tone, but why did Suryakumar lose his cool?
item.description: Ishan Kishan smashed a sensational 76 off just 32 balls to rescue India after an early collapse and set up a dominant chase against New Zealand. His counter-attacking knock powered India to a series-clinching win.

item.title: KRK arrested in Oshiwara firing case; Admits shots fired from licensed gun
item.description: Mumbai Police have arrested actor and self-styled film critic Kamaal R Khan in connection with the Oshiwara firing incident. The firing, which occurred at a residential building in Andheri, involved four rounds allegedly discharged from KRK’s licensed firearm.
